nosotros.title: SantiPulse · About Me
nosotros.metaDescription: About Santi — creator of SantiPulse. Portfolio, certificates, real websites and AI systems for businesses.
nosotros.intro: I am Santi, the creator of SantiPulse. I build websites, AI assistants and automations that help businesses look sharper, respond faster and save time.
nosotros.missionP1: I like building tools that feel clear, modern and useful: a website that builds trust, a chatbot that actually answers or a dashboard that organizes daily work.
nosotros.missionP2: SantiPulse is how I combine design, automation and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into products people can use and proudly show.
nosotros.believe1Body: A portfolio should show real projects, not only promises. That is why I show websites, demos and live systems.
nosotros.believe2Body: AI matters when it removes repetitive tasks and creates more space to sell, serve and create.
nosotros.believe3Body: I work closely with you: I listen to the business, suggest solutions and build something you can use.
nosotros.do1Body: Assistants for insurance, safety, customer support and 24/7 service.
nosotros.do2Body: Modern pages for businesses, personal brands and services.
nosotros.do3Body: Panels for leads, bookings, analysis and repetitive tasks.
